Description: All composite materials used in nacelle primary structure shall be qualified per AC 20-107B with B-basis allowables.
Acceptance_Criteria: B-basis allowables established; batch acceptance testing

Description: Titanium and aluminum alloys shall meet MMPDS/CMH-17 specifications with A-basis or B-basis allowables as applicable.
Acceptance_Criteria: Material properties per MMPDS; supplier qualification

Description: Acoustic panel materials shall meet fire protection requirements and maintain acoustic performance over service life.
Acceptance_Criteria: Flammability per FAR 25 Appendix F; acoustic absorption ≥90%

Description: Structural sealants and adhesives shall be qualified for environmental exposure and maintain bond strength over design service life.
Acceptance_Criteria: Lap shear strength retention ≥80% after environmental exposure

Description: Materials in engine heat zones shall maintain structural properties at operating temperatures up to 200°C continuous.
Acceptance_Criteria: Mechanical properties maintained at 200°C; no degradation
